      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
      name: autoverse-demo
      element: someip-bridge
    realizationClass: virtual
    targetId: someip-bridge-target
    artifactIds:
    - autoverse-contract
    lifecycle: *id001
  - id: score-binding
    logicalRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
      name: autoverse-demo
      element: score
    realizationClass: virtual
    targetId: score-target

documents.xdl/scenario.xdl.yaml:
apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
kind: Scenario
metadata:
  namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
  name: interactive-drive
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Interactive driving with immutable source and a bounded native 
    session.
  provenance:
    source: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:classic:1.0
    revision: 1.0.0
    maturity: prototype
    limitations:
    - Requires separately installed and admitted native Autoverse services; 
      loading starts nothing.
    - External communication is not native X-COM or a coupled solver; simulation
      time remains unmapped.
spec:
  systemRef:
    apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
    kind: System
    namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
    name: autoverse-demo
  deploymentRef:
    apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
    kind: Deployment
    namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
    name: local-autoverse
  initialConditions:
    driverSurface: studio-browser
    initialBrakingRequest: 1
    initialCruiseRequest: false
    initialReverseRequest: false
    simulatorAdvancement: public-vehicle-cli-synchronous
    fixedDeltaSeconds: 0.05
  steps:
  - id: start-autoverse
    actionKind: start
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
      name: autoverse-demo
      element: carla
    timeDomainId: host-runtime
    schedule:
      at: 0
      unit: s
    action:
      operation: run-autoverse-classic
  observers:
  - id: autoverse-telemetry
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
      name: autoverse-demo
      element: vehicle-speed-flow
    timeDomainId: host-runtime
    samplingIntent: Bounded latest interface observations; source simulation 
      time unavailable and receipt age separate.
    payloadSchema: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:telemetry:v1
    unitSemantics: per-field
    evidenceSinkRef: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:journal
  - id: autoverse-fault-records
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: System
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
      name: autoverse-demo
      element: driver
    timeDomainId: host-runtime
    samplingIntent: Retrospective enumeration of recorded bridge-lease 
      acknowledgement events; not continuous state or vehicle effects.
    payloadSchema: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:fault-record-assessment:1.0
    unitSemantics: boolean event fields; dimensionless counts
    evidenceSinkRef: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:journal
  metrics:
  - id: reported-speed
    observerIds:
    - autoverse-telemetry
    calculationRef: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:reported-speed-intent:v1
    unitSemantics: km/h
    acceptance: Opaque metric intent only; no compatible evaluator or verdict is
      claimed.
  acceptanceIntent: Load, start, drive and stop the actual complete stack; 
    process startup alone is not successful vehicle control.
  faults:
  - id: first-loss
    activation: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:input-loss:1.0:activation
    extensions:
      io.xverse.experiment:
        duration:
          unit: s
          value: 3
        kind: fault-intent
        schemaVersion: '0.1'
        target:
          apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
          element: first-loss
          kind: Scenario
          name: interactive-drive
          namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
        timeDomainId: host-runtime
        trigger:
          at: 5000
          kind: time
          unit: ms
    faultKind: driver-input-loss
    maturity: prototype
    recovery: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:input-loss:1.0:recovery
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      element: driver
      kind: System
      name: autoverse-demo
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
  - id: second-loss
    activation: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:input-loss:1.0:activation
    extensions:
      io.xverse.experiment:
        duration:
          unit: s
          value: 3
        kind: fault-intent
        schemaVersion: '0.1'
        target:
          apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
          element: second-loss
          kind: Scenario
          name: interactive-drive
          namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
        timeDomainId: host-runtime
        trigger:
          at: 13
          kind: time
          unit: s
    faultKind: driver-input-loss
    maturity: prototype
    recovery: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:input-loss:1.0:recovery
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      element: driver
      kind: System
      name: autoverse-demo
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
  - id: interrupted-loss
    activation: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:input-loss:1.0:activation
    extensions:
      io.xverse.experiment:
        duration:
          unit: s
          value: 3
        kind: fault-intent
        schemaVersion: '0.1'
        target:
          apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
          element: interrupted-loss
          kind: Scenario
          name: interactive-drive
          namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
        timeDomainId: host-runtime
        trigger:
          at: 21
          kind: time
          unit: s
    faultKind: driver-input-loss
    maturity: prototype
    recovery: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:input-loss:1.0:recovery
    targetRef:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      element: driver
      kind: System
      name: autoverse-demo
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
extensions:
  io.xverse.experiment:
    schemaVersion: '0.1'
    kind: scenario-intent
    target:
      apiVersion: xverse.io/xdl/v1alpha1
      kind: Scenario
      namespace: org.xverse.studio.autoverse
      name: interactive-drive
    seed:
      value: 0
      unitSemantics: not-a-determinism-claim
    parameters: []
    fidelityLimitations:
    - An interactive external runtime; no deterministic replay or scientific 
      model equivalence is claimed.
  io.xverse.studio.native-runtime:
    version: '1.0'
    kind: scenario
    providerId: autoverse.demo
    contractRef: urn:xverse:studio:autoverse:classic:1.0
    durationSeconds: 30
    inputSurface: studio-browser
  io.xverse.studio.experiments:
    version: '1.0'
    definitions:
    - version: '1.0'
      kind: assertion
      systemRef: xdl://org.xverse.studio.autoverse/system/autoverse-demo
      scenarioRef: xdl://org.xverse.studio.autoverse/scenario/interactive-drive
      coveragePolicy: complete
      window:
        clockDomainRef: host-runtime
        startTick: '0'
        endTick: '10000000'
      evaluationId: bridge-loss-acknowledged
      name: Bridge loss acknowledged
      expression:
        kind: aggregate
        operator: any
        input:
          kind: signal
          observerRef: autoverse-fault-records
          field: activationObserved
    - version: '1.0'
      kind: assertion
      systemRef: xdl://org.xverse.studio.autoverse/system/autoverse-demo
      scenarioRef: xdl://org.xverse.studio.autoverse/scenario/interactive-drive
      coveragePolicy: complete
      window:
        clockDomainRef: host-runtime
        startTick: '0'
        endTick: '10000000'
      evaluationId: two-recoveries-before-ten-seconds
      name: Two recoveries before ten seconds
      expression:
        kind: compare
        operator: ge
        left:
          kind: aggregate
          operator: count
          input:
            kind: signal
            observerRef: autoverse-fault-records
            field: recoveryObserved
        right:
          kind: literal
          value: 2
          unit: '1'
    - version: '1.0'
      kind: assertion
      systemRef: xdl://org.xverse.studio.autoverse/system/autoverse-demo

      coveragePolicy: complete

          kind: signal
          observerRef: autoverse-fault-records
          field: recoveryObserved
    - version: '1.0'
      kind: metric
      systemRef: xdl://org.xverse.studio.autoverse/system/autoverse-demo
